text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children in Islam and mentions Prophetic hadiths that urge raising children with mercy and justice. It also highlights the importance of teaching children Salah and patience in their tarbiyah (upbringing). Parents must focus on nurturing their children upon religious values and akhlaq (moral character).

review_defects.why: The Arabic refers to 'religious and moral values' (two types of values), but the English renders the second as 'akhlaq (moral character)', changing 'moral values' to a noun meaning moral character and dropping the word 'values' for the moral aspect.
